Doll Specification Sheet

Every doll in our range, numbered. Please look through them and tell us which stock codes you can supply.

Issued 17 August 2026 · 18 dolls

How to reply

Each doll has a stock code. You do not need to write a long reply. Simply list the codes you can make, for example: "We can supply stock codes 1, 2, 5 and 9."

Click any photograph to open it full size. Use the arrow keys to move between photos and press Escape to close.

The photographs are of our own products. They show exactly the doll, the face, the hair and the outfit we want. Where a photograph and our written description disagree, the photograph is correct.
